payload.answer: It shouldnt be parsing specific strings, just understand when a study is requested and understand what tools, workflows should be used

options.description: 'A study of how merges are held' is offered. 'Study the failing test and fix it' is not, because 'study' is just a verb there. A bare 'a study room' offers nothing.
options.label: Only with a clear topic (Recommended)

options.description: 'Give me a study room' is offered too and asks you for the topic. 'Study the failing test' could also trigger offers you don't want.
options.label: Also a bare 'study room'

payload.question: You wrote that plumb answered a study request with 'I'll check how plumb builds a requested study first'. You said a built-in feature shouldn't need the agent to discover it. Plumb will now recognise 'a study of <topic>' in your message and offer it in the band. Should it also offer when you write only 'a study room' or 'study the failing test', with no clear topic?
